requirement.description: The WebDAV test is failing because authentication challenges return 403 Forbidden instead of 401 Unauthorized when the user lacks write access. This violates the WebDAV protocol expectation that unauthorized access attempts should return 401.
requirement.contract: When a user attempts to access a resource with insufficient permissions, the server should return a 401 Unauthorized response instead of 403 Forbidden for authentication challenges. Specifically, when the user is '*' (unauthenticated) and the volume requires authentication (davauth flag), it should return 401.

requirement.description: The dirkey/thumb test is failing because thumbnail generation is returning an e404 error instead of e403 when a user without proper access tries to view a thumbnail. The system should properly return 403 for forbidden access to thumbnails.
requirement.contract: When a user attempts to access a thumbnail with insufficient permissions, the server should return a 403 Forbidden response with an appropriate error message (e.g., "e403") instead of a 404 Not Found error.

requirement.description: The copy operation test is failing because the server returns 405 Method Not Allowed instead of 201 Created when processing copy operations. This indicates that the POST handler for copy operations is not implemented or properly configured.
requirement.contract: When a valid copy operation is performed via POST with a copy action, the server should respond with 201 Created status indicating successful processing of the operation.
